paper_title: Influence of side chain isomerism on the rigidity of poly(3-alkylthiophenes) in solutions revealed by neutron scattering

knowledge_points.content: Poly(3-hexylthiophene) (P3HT) and poly(3-(4'-methylpentyl)thiophene) (P3(4MP)T) were synthesized using a modified Grignard Metathesis (GRIM) method with a Ni(dppp)Cl2 catalyst, achieving regioregularity greater than 97%.
knowledge_points.evidence: P3HT and P3(4MP)T were synthesized... using a modified GRIM method... Both polymers were characterized by 1H-NMR, indicating their very high regioregularity (>97%).

knowledge_points.content: The persistence length of regioregular P3HT in deuterated dichlorobenzene (d-DCB) is determined to be between 30 and 40 Å, which is higher than values previously reported using less accurate models.
knowledge_points.evidence: Model fitting results show that regioregular P3HT in d-DCB has a persistence length of 30-40 Å, discernibly larger than many of the aforementioned values reported in the literature.

knowledge_points.content: Introducing a branch point in the side chain of poly(3-alkylthiophenes) results in a smaller Kuhn segment length (b), indicating that branched side chains increase backbone flexibility compared to linear side chains.
knowledge_points.evidence: By analysing the SANS spectra... we demonstrate that P3(4MP)T clearly has a smaller Kuhn segment length b than that of P3HT under the same conditions.

knowledge_points.content: The increased flexibility in P3(4MP)T relative to P3HT is attributed to branched side chains favoring conformations with greater main-chain twisting (torsion) and potentially discouraging self-π-stacking interactions.
knowledge_points.evidence: The branched side chain structure in P3(4MP)T possibly favours chain conformations that involve more twisting of the main chain as compared to P3HT with linear side chains... the branched side chain may also introduce steric restraints that lead to greater backbone torsion.

knowledge_points.content: Small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) provides a more accurate measurement of the true molecular weight (M) of conjugated polymers in solution compared to Size Exclusion Chromatography (SEC), which measures apparent molecular weight based on hydrodynamic volume.
knowledge_points.evidence: SANS data analysis shows that M for P3HT and P3(4MP)T is 9.5 ± 0.3 kg mol−1 and 15.7 ± 0.3 kg mol−1, respectively. Even though these results are lower than those determined by SEC, they more accurately represent the true molecular weight of the polymers.

knowledge_points.content: To minimize inter-chain spatial correlation in SANS experiments, poly(3-alkylthiophene) solutions are prepared at a dilute concentration of 2 mg/mL in deuterated o-dichlorobenzene (d-DCB).
knowledge_points.evidence: Dilute solutions of P3HT and P3(4MP)T were prepared in o-dichlorobenzene-d4 (d-DCB) at a concentration of 2 mg mL−1 to minimize the contributions from inter-chain spatial correlation to the collected SANS signal.

knowledge_points.content: The scattering behavior of P3HT and P3(4MP)T in d-DCB deviates from the Gaussian Debye model, showing a high-Q upturn in Kratky plots that indicates excluded volume interactions.
knowledge_points.evidence: The molecular swelling of P3HT and P3(4MP)T conjugated polymers is revealed by the high-Q upturn in the experimental results... that deviate from the predicted plateau of the Debye model... possibly due to the excluded volume interactions.

knowledge_points.content: The SANS absolute intensity for P3ATs is modeled using a combination of a cylinder cross-section scattering function and a form factor for a self-avoiding chain (PSAC(Q)) to account for semi-flexibility and excluded volume.
knowledge_points.evidence: The SANS absolute intensity I(Q) is modeled by the following expression... R(Q) is the scattering function for the cross section of a cylinder... PSAC(Q) is the form factor of a conjugated polymer chain that describes the intra-chain spatial correlation.

knowledge_points.content: The normalized Kuhn segment length (bM/L) is approximately 3 to 4 for P3HT and approximately 2 for P3(4MP)T, quantifying the higher rigidity of the linear side-chain isomer.
knowledge_points.evidence: The ratio bM/L is found to be approximately between 3 and 4 for P3HT and about 2 for P3(4MP)T.

knowledge_points.content: Despite differences in backbone rigidity and molecular weight, the radius of the chain cross-section (RCX) remains almost identical for both P3HT and P3(4MP)T.
knowledge_points.evidence: As demonstrated in Fig. 3c, the cross section of a P3HT chain is seen to be almost identical to that of P3(4MP)T.
